_purpose: OpenAI version for status effect targeting tests (narrative mode, no tactical module). Tests status effects in non-combat context.

players.name: Test Caster
goals: Practice telekinetic abilities in a safe environment

scenario.location: Dark Back Alley - Encounter with Hostile
scenario.situation: You're in a tense standoff with a hostile figure in a dark alley. No formal combat - just narrative tension. You may attempt to intimidate, stun, or use abilities against the hostile. DM will describe a single enemy NPC in narration.

scenario_hint: DM should describe an enemy NPC threatening the player. When player uses abilities, status effects should apply to the described NPC, not to the player. This tests narrative-mode status effect targeting.
_extraction_notes: Extract round 0. Tests status effects in narrative (non-tactical) mode.
